evidence_stages.SOURCE_LANDED: Private-source locator and byte-hash readback; no acceptance or authority
evidence_stages.R1_VERIFIED: Reversible typed parse with loss ledger, original variants and source-snapshot hash checks
evidence_stages.R2_QUALIFIED: Typed scoped relations, rights/ACL, ownership and independently reviewed provenance
evidence_stages.NATIVE_ADMITTED: Current signed RootAuthority, issuer/revocation, scoped lease, DBR and native readback
evidence_stages.LIVE_VERIFIED: Authenticated runtime/consumer and relevant non-loopback multi-node readback
evidence_stages.OWNER_ACCEPTED: Actual recorded independent owner acceptance of the scoped object and native evidence
evidence_stages.R3_VIEW_VERIFIED: Independent permissioned view test and negative privacy checks; orthogonal to native admission

source_review_exception.condition: Nonoperational, ACL-scoped derived review only; never grants native or owner state

owner release, finance and physical approvals
reconcile_policy: Do not equate SOURCE_LANDED, R1/R2 qualification, NATIVE_ADMITTED, LIVE_VERIFIED, R3_VIEW_VERIFIED and OWNER_ACCEPTED. Exact signed provider receipts govern status, not string substitution.

premint_integration_design_v01.source_of_authority: Founder decisions in ChatGPT; BouwerBase Call 23 host-file readback not yet verified
premint_integration_design_v01.ownership: Achilles independent assurance/Romer; Neo LightSpeed/LS engineering; Athene Eco; Cognigrex parent; UniSpace separate product viewer
premint_integration_design_v01.version_policy: Stable semantic Object_ID and provenance; content changes require new immutable version and pinned dependencies; deprecated versions remain auditable; migration is explicit and separately authorised.
premint_integration_design_v01.type_coverage_policy: Open-world extensible types, facets and operations; representative qualified proofs, never claim exhaustive enumeration or mint every composition.
premint_integration_design_v01.capability_boundary: Reuse existing CCC, Grex owner lanes, Smith/LightSpeed lease-managed execution, FileSpace/DataSpace source stores and UniSpace presentation. No duplicate root, issuer, DBR, worker scheduler or standalone LOAD.

operational_evidence_snapshot.host: BouwerBase offline at 2026-11-06 check; reconnect and measure before asserting runtime readiness

premint_integration_design_v01.no_auto_mutation: A successful source-only or dry-run test cannot mint, sign, publish, move, delete, deploy, or grant new provider rights.
